messages:
Ana R: opened PR to clarify compat notes and limits for 'compact' variants and to fix a broken benchmarks CSV link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/499
Victor D: what are the main doc fixes?
Ana R: short list: correct declared max_sequence for compact builds (was overstated), add an explicit "effective_max_sequence" row for quant vs fp variants, add a small SDK snippet showing embeddings.generate usage with truncate, replace dead bench CSV link, and add runtime requirements for q4_1 and nnint8.
Maya C: can you paste the SDK snippet for embeddings vs generate? we had confusion last week when people used the wrong method name across SDK versions
Ana R: snippet pasted in PR desc:
```python
# SDK v3+: embeddings - explicit truncate to avoid silent truncation
resp = client.embeddings.generate(model="compact", input=["very long document"], truncate=True)
# legacy SDK v2.x (for reference):
resp_legacy = client.embeddings.create(model="compact", input=["very long document"])
```
Victor D: please add note: "truncate=True will drop tokens exceeding the model context" and link to chunking guidance
Ana R: added note and chunking link; also included recommended chunk formula: min(model_context - 256, 8192).
bench-bot: uploaded updated CSV and bench dashboard entry: https://bench.redwood.ai/2026/compact-summary.csv
docs-bot: docs CI linkcheck passed and lint OK :white_check_mark: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/499
Maya C: QA will smoke test snippets on staging docs-preview after lunch
Ana R: rebased and merged after CI green. leaving follow-up to auto-generate declared vs effective tables from bench metadata: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/issues/256
Victor D: added infra follow-up to detect dead bench links in PRs touching benchmarks
Ana R: closing thread thanks everyone
